definitions.explanation: One of the most common Japanese surnames, literally meaning 'in the rice field.'

examples.japanese: {田中|たなか}{夫妻|ふさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招待|しょうたい}→招待：01435_shoutai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I invited the Tanakas (Mr. and Mrs. Tanaka).

examples.japanese: {田中|たなか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：00607_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：00413_ooi⟧⟦{名字|みょうじ}→名字：02679_myouji⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Tanaka is a common surname in Japan.

notes:
{田中|たなか} is one of the most common Japanese surnames.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {田|た}: rice field
- {中|なか}: middle, inside
- Literally: "in the rice field"
